in_sanskrit.name: उत्तरा
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is from the north, or who is higher.

in_hindi.name: उत्तरा

in_marathi.name: Uttaraa
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे The latter, the following
in_marathi.long_meaning: Uttaraa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Uttaraa refers to the latter or the following, often used in mythology to denote the second or following avatar.
